topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I can't believe this, how could everything just fall apart like this? I know how much you were looking forward to it, and now... I don't even know what to do to make it right. I felt like this party was going to be perfect, a surprise that was going to light up your whole year. Everyone was so excited, and now they're all saying they're sorry, but it just feels like it's all slipping away. I wish I could wave a magic wand and fix it, because you deserve the best. I’m going to try and sort this out, I promise. Just hang in there with me, okay? We’ll figure something out, something even better.
